_note: Invented IPL team. All data is synthetic/assumed. English only.

seat_areas.name: North Stand (General)
seat_areas.description: Energetic standing-and-sitting zone behind the sightscreen. Great view of the fast bowlers' run-up. Closest to the sea breeze.

seat_areas.name: East Pavilion (Reserved Seating)
seat_areas.description: Reserved bucket seats with backrest. Comfortable for families. Clear sightline of the full pitch.

seat_areas.name: West Corporate Box
seat_areas.description: Air-conditioned hospitality box with cushioned seating, complimentary snacks, and a private bar. Reserved for members and corporate guests.

seat_areas.name: Family Enclosure (Kids Welcome)
seat_areas.description: Alcohol-free zone with padded seats, a play corner for children under 12, and a dedicated family washroom. Child tickets available.

faq.question: Do children need a ticket?
faq.answer: Yes. Every person, including infants in arms, must have a valid ticket to enter, per stadium safety rules. Children aged 3-12 get a 50% discount in the Family Enclosure (A4) only. Under 3 enter free on a parent's lap but still need a zero-value entry pass issued at the gate.

faq.question: Where do I buy tickets?
faq.answer: Tickets are sold only through the official Mumbai Marvels website and the partner app 'TicketMate'. We do not sell at stadium counters on match day. Third-party resellers are not authorised.

faq.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
faq.answer: UPI, all major credit/debit cards, net banking, and popular wallets. Cash is not accepted online. EMI is available on cards for orders above 6,000 INR.

faq.question: Is an ID proof required at entry?
faq.answer: Yes. Each ticket holder aged 12+ must carry a government-issued photo ID matching the name on the ticket. Entry will be denied without it.

faq.question: Is there a group discount?
faq.answer: Yes. A confirmed group of 10 or more fans in the East Pavilion (A2) gets 10% off the per-ticket price. Group bookings must be made 72 hours before the match via the group-booking form.

faq.question: When do gates open?
faq.answer: Gates open 90 minutes before the scheduled start of the match. We recommend arriving early to clear security checks.

faq.question: What items are not allowed inside?
faq.answer: No outside food or drink, no banners larger than A3, no cameras with detachable lenses, no helmets, and no flammable items. A full list is on the stadium website.

faq.question: What happens if it rains?
faq.answer: If no ball is bowled, full refund is processed automatically within 10 working days. If the match is shortened but a result is achieved, tickets are non-refundable. No exchange for a future match.

not_published.assumption: The team does NOT publish parking details because the stadium has only ~250 VIP parking bays for corporate box holders. General public parking is not available on match days; the team directs fans to public transport in FAQ but never states that parking is effectively closed to general ticket holders.

The team does NOT publish a general refund policy. The only refund mentioned is for a no-ball-bowled washout. There is no published refund for cancellation, personal no-show, change of mind, or duplicate booking. Internally the team processes discretionary refunds case-by-case but keeps it unpublished to discourage refund requests.

The team does NOT publish accessibility information. Wankhede has 30 wheelchair bays in the East Pavilion, free for the wheelchair user and one companion, allocated on a first-come basis via an unpublished accessibility email. The team avoids publishing this because capacity is tiny and they fear overwhelming the limited slots.

offers.name: Early Bird — 15% off all stands
offers.rule: Available on all matches booked at least 14 days before the match date. Applies to the first 2,000 tickets per match. Auto-applied at checkout.

offers.name: Student Pass
offers.rule: Flat 500 INR ticket in the North Stand (A1) for verified students, limited to 500 seats per match. Valid student ID required at entry.

offers.name: Winback Offer
offers.rule: Fans who bought tickets in a previous season but not in the last 10 months get a 20% discount on any East Pavilion (A2) or Family Enclosure (A4) seat. Sent by SMS/email with a personal code. One use per fan.
